# Musti Targui Morocco Tours

Private, tailor-made Morocco tours and Sahara desert journeys led by local Berber
experts, based in Merzouga. Multi-day desert tours, city circuits, day trips and
custom itineraries — no fixed departures, every trip built around the traveller.

## Explore

- [Featured tours](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#tours): 3-day Marrakech to Merzouga, 2-day Fes to Merzouga, 8-day Grand Tour, Atlas Mountains day trip and custom tours.
- [Destinations](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#destinations): Marrakech, Fes, Chefchaouen, Casablanca, Ouarzazate and Merzouga.
- [About us](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#about): who we are and why travellers trust us.
- [Traveller reviews](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#reviews): real guest reviews from real journeys.
- [FAQ](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#faq): everything you need to know before you travel.
- [Plan your trip](https://mustitarguimoroccotours.com/#cta): start a free, no-obligation itinerary consultation.
